web_admin_pages.title: Dashboard Tổng quan
features: Executive overview of platform activity
Live exam attempt counters
Score distribution metrics

web_admin_pages.title: Quản lý đề thi V-SAT 2026
features: Browse all exams with status badges (DRAFT, PENDING_REVIEW, PUBLISHED, ARCHIVED, HIDDEN)
Subject and keyword search filter
Publish, hide, archive, discard draft actions
Quick navigation to Exam Creation Wizard

web_admin_pages.title: Tạo đề thi mới (Wizard 4 bước)
features: Step 1 General: exam code, title, subject, duration (60/90m), difficulty, passing threshold
Step 2 Composition: matrix blueprint picker or manual question picker with live constraint validation
Step 3 Preview: question list preview with KaTeX rendering, reorder and delete questions
Step 4 Variants & Publish: generate randomized question variants (hoán vị) and one-click publish

web_admin_pages.title: Ma trận đề thi V-SAT
features: Inspect standard GDPT 2018 blueprint matrices for Math, English, Physics
Detailed matrix cell inspection across 4 question formats (True/False, MCQ, Matching, Short Answer)
One-click action to launch Exam Wizard seeded with chosen blueprint

web_admin_pages.title: Ca thi & Lịch thi
features: Manage official examination windows (Ca thi & Lịch thi)
Create, update start/end datetime, and link target exam
Change status between UPCOMING, RUNNING, and CLOSED
Delete obsolete examination schedule windows

web_admin_pages.title: Ngân hàng câu hỏi V-SAT 2026
features: Search and filter questions by subject, format, difficulty, cognitive level
Interactive question authoring modal (QuestionCreateModal)
KaTeX preview for math equations
Sub-items and answer key configuration

web_admin_pages.title: Hàng đợi duyệt câu hỏi V-SAT
features: Triage collaborator-submitted questions awaiting review
One-click approve question to master bank
Request revision with detailed feedback comment
Reject question with reason

web_admin_pages.title: Import câu hỏi
features: Upload Excel (.xlsx) file to bulk import questions

Real-time validation error reporting with row-by-row diagnostics

web_admin_pages.title: Cấu hình hệ thống

web_admin_pages.title: MathView KaTeX Renderer
features: KaTeX equation parsing ($...$ inline, $$...$$ display, \[...\] blocks)
Dynamic math auto-render for administrative preview surfaces
